## [1.1.1](https://github.com/Nizarberyan/Avito-Patches/compare/v1.1.0...v1.1.1) (2026-11-12)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Hide sponsored campaigns on every screen ([e8b78ab](https://github.com/Nizarberyan/Avito-Patches/commit/e8b78ab6e6d184785673fe6df09ad84e295bc5c1))

patches.name: Change installer source
patches.description: Spoofs the installer source so the app appears to be installed from an app store.

patches.name: Clone app
patches.description: Changes the app package name to allow installing the same app multiple times. By default ".morphe" is appended to the package name. Each cloned install must use a unique package name. Cloning does not work with all apps and using this patch may cause app crashes or other unexpected behavior.

options.description: Package name to use for the cloned app.
Update custom permissions declared by the app. Fixes installation conflicts, but can break features in certain apps.
Update provider names declared by the app. Fixes installation conflicts, but can break features in certain apps.

patches.name: Disable Play Store updates
patches.description: Disables Play Store updates by setting the version code to the maximum allowed. This patch may cause unexpected issues with some apps and does not work if the app is installed by root mounting

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes the ad network banners from the search results and from the listing pages, and stops the app from requesting ads.

patches.name: Hide shop listings
patches.description: Hides listings posted by shops (boutiques) from the home feed and from search results. Search results show shop listings again when a seller type is selected in the search filters.

patches.name: Hide sponsored campaigns
patches.description: Removes the sponsored campaigns Avito serves itself on every screen: the sticky banner, notification ads, swipe-up ads and touching points.

patches.name: Override certificate pinning
patches.description: Overrides certificate pinning, allowing to inspect traffic via a proxy.

patches.name: Spoof signature
patches.description: Spoofs the package signature of the original APK.
